latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Video Script skill.

- Generate ready-to-film video scripts from text, briefs, or uploaded files (TXT, DOCX, PDF, MP4 up to 200MB).
- Fast cloud AI processing: scripts and 1080p MP4 videos in 20–40 seconds.
- Seamless onboarding with free starter credits—no install needed.
- Supports script customization for YouTubers, marketers, and creators.
- Export videos in a variety of formats including MP4, MOV, AVI, WEBM, and more.
